info.title: SAP Commerce Cloud OCC REST API
info.description: SAP Commerce Cloud Omni Commerce Connect (OCC) REST API provides access to core commerce functionality including product catalog, shopping carts, orders, and user management. The OCC API follows RESTful conventions and is the primary API for storefront and headless commerce integrations.

servers.description: SAP Commerce Cloud OCC v2 endpoint

baseUrl.description: Base URL of your SAP Commerce Cloud instance

get.description: Searches for products in the catalog with full-text search, filtering, sorting, and faceting capabilities.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Full-text search query or Solr query

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort code (e.g. relevance, topRated, name-asc, name-desc, price-asc, price-desc)

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Response field configuration (BASIC, DEFAULT, FULL, or specific fields)

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific product by its code.
Retrieves reviews for a specific product.

parameters.name: maxCount
parameters.description: Maximum number of reviews to return

post.description: Creates a new review for a product.

get.description: Retrieves all catalogs for the base site.
Retrieves a specific category within a catalog version.
Retrieves all carts for a user. Use 'current' for authenticated user or 'anonymous' for anonymous carts.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User ID, email, or 'current' for authenticated user, 'anonymous' for guest

post.description: Creates a new cart for the user.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific cart.
Retrieves all entries (line items) in a cart.

post.description: Adds a new product entry to the cart.

patch.description: Updates the quantity of an existing cart entry.

delete.description: Removes an entry from the cart.

post.description: Sets or creates a delivery address for the cart.

get.description: Returns the delivery mode selected for the cart.

put.description: Sets the delivery mode for the cart.

get.description: Returns all delivery modes available for the cart.
Retrieves the order history for a user.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Comma-separated order statuses to filter by

post.description: Places an order from the specified cart. The cart must have a delivery address, delivery mode, and payment details set.

parameters.name: cartId
parameters.description: Cart ID to place as order

parameters.name: termsChecked
parameters.description: Whether terms and conditions were accepted

400.description: Bad Request - cart not ready for checkout

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific order.

uid.description: User email address used as unique ID

titleCode.description: Title code (mr, mrs, miss, ms, dr, rev)

get.description: Retrieves all addresses in the user's address book.

post.description: Creates a new address in the user's address book.

get.description: Retrieves all stored payment details for a user.
Searches for physical stores based on location or query.
Returns all available currencies for the base store.
Returns all available languages for the base store.
Returns all available titles (Mr, Mrs, etc.).

oauth2.description: SAP Commerce Cloud OAuth 2.0 authentication. Client credentials for server-to-server, authorization code or resource owner password for user-context operations.
